text:
mira (PM): kickoff: we need a compact plan for an alpha release of console visibility (dashboards, tracing hooks, route-level cost). goal: get something alpha-ready for 10 customers in 6 weeks. who can own which slice?

noah (eng-runtime): runtime constraint: sync span emit will regress p99. plan: lightweight header propagation + async span buffer (sidecar or background thread). estimate 2 sprints to land primitives.

anya (cust-succ): top customer asks: per-route cost links and the ability to mute alerts. customers will judge the product by the accuracy of per-route spend.

lee (obs-ux): alpha UX: single "Visibility" dashboard showing spend trend, error rate, and top 10 traces. keep the investigate view minimal: prioritized trace list + waterfall. show a clear "sampled" badge when attribution is estimated.

cass (data): attribution design: hybrid model. full-capture for named high-value routes (configurable), sampling elsewhere. will emit confidence metrics so UI can show error bars. storage: raw spans for 7 days default.

infra-bot: policy-template: {"trigger":"node_cpu>80%","action":"disable_span_emitter","scope":"node"}

sam (eng-sre): rollout suggestion: dark-launch hooks, then 0.25% prod traffic alpha for first week, expand to 1% for second week. acceptance: p99 latency regression < 2% and no unexplained error spikes.

mira (PM): proposed milestones:
- M1 (primitives): id propagation, async emitter, cost event schema
- M2 (alpha): visibility dashboard, sampled traces, per-route CSV export (alpha tenants)
- M3 (beta): alerts, per-route billing export, retention tiers

noah (eng-runtime): implementation note: M2 can be sampled-only traces + precomputed waterfalls to avoid heavy hot-path joins. M3 needs storage + export infra.

cass (data): retention options: default 7d raw, aggregated 30d. paid add-on: 30d raw. compression + proto encoding gives ~2x reduction in storage. include ballpark monthly cost numbers in FRD.

anya (cust-succ): sales asks: include language about approximation in billing for sampled tenants. enterprise customers can opt into deterministic capture for audit months.

lee (obs-ux): alpha SLOs for UI: dashboard initial load < 900ms, trace list render < 1.2s for sampled traces. display a tooltip explaining sampling and confidence.

mira (PM): open decisions before FRD: default sampling rate, hybrid-route selection rules, retention pricing grid, PII redaction defaults.

sam (eng-sre): I'll draft the canary playbook and incident rollback triggers. infra-bot: add rule to thread when ready.

noah (eng-runtime): I'll size the runtime changes and propose a B-scope that keeps heavy enrichment off the request path.

cass (data): I'll produce a cost vs accuracy table and estimated ops cost for 10 alpha customers.

mira (PM): next steps: FRD draft due in 4 business days, mockups from Lee in 48 hours, canary playbook from Sam in 72 hours. sync Monday 11am PT. drop any blockers here. :rocket:
